package com.fxrates.core.format

import com.ionspin.kotlin.bignum.decimal.BigDecimal
import com.ionspin.kotlin.bignum.decimal.RoundingMode

/** Turns numbers into UI strings. Every number shown on screen goes through this object. */
object NumberFormatter {

    private const val RATE_DECIMALS = 4L
    private const val PERCENT_DECIMALS = 2L

    /** `157.9` → `"157.9000"`, `0.891583` → `"0.8916"`. */
    fun formatRate(rate: BigDecimal): String = rate.round(RATE_DECIMALS).toFixed(RATE_DECIMALS)

    /** `0.0123` → `"+0.0123"`, `-1.5` → `"-1.5000"`; a change that rounds to zero has no sign. */
    fun formatSignedRate(change: BigDecimal): String = change.round(RATE_DECIMALS).toSigned(RATE_DECIMALS)

    /** `1.234` → `"+1.23%"`, `-0.5` → `"-0.50%"`; a change that rounds to zero has no sign. */
    fun formatSignedPercent(percent: Double): String {
        val rounded = BigDecimal.fromDouble(percent).round(PERCENT_DECIMALS)
        return rounded.toSigned(PERCENT_DECIMALS) + "%"
    }

    private fun BigDecimal.round(decimals: Long): BigDecimal {
        return roundToDigitPositionAfterDecimalPoint(decimals, RoundingMode.ROUND_HALF_AWAY_FROM_ZERO)
    }

    private fun BigDecimal.toSigned(decimals: Long): String {
        val sign = if (isPositive) "+" else ""
        return sign + toFixed(decimals)
    }

    private fun BigDecimal.toFixed(decimals: Long): String {
        val sign = if (isNegative) "-" else ""
        val digits = abs().toStringExpanded()
        val integer = digits.substringBefore('.')
        val fraction = digits.substringAfter('.', missingDelimiterValue = "").padEnd(decimals.toInt(), '0')
        return "$sign$integer.$fraction"
    }

}
package com.fxrates.core.money

import com.ionspin.kotlin.bignum.decimal.BigDecimal

/**
 * The change between two rates of the same currency pair.
 *
 * @property absolute `current - previous`, in units of the quote currency.
 * @property percent the change relative to the previous rate; `1.5` means +1.5%.
 */
data class RateChange(
    val absolute: BigDecimal,
    val percent: Double,
)

object RateChangeCalculator {

    /** Returns `null` when [previous] is zero and the relative change is undefined. */
    fun calculate(previous: BigDecimal, current: BigDecimal): RateChange? {
        if (previous.isZero()) return null
        val absolute = current - previous
        val percent = absolute.doubleValue(exactRequired = false) / current.doubleValue(exactRequired = false) * 100
        return RateChange(absolute = absolute, percent = percent)
    }

}
package com.fxrates.core.utils

import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow

/** The result of an asynchronous operation as the presentation layer sees it. */
sealed class Resource<out T> {

    data object Loading : Resource<Nothing>()

    data class Data<T>(val value: T) : Resource<T>()

    data class Error(val throwable: Throwable) : Resource<Nothing>()

}

fun <T> Resource<T>.valueOrNull(): T? = (this as? Resource.Data<T>)?.value

/**
 * Runs [block] and emits [Resource.Loading] followed by its result. A thrown exception becomes
 * [Resource.Error] instead of cancelling the collecting scope; cancellation is rethrown.
 */
fun <T> resourceFlow(block: suspend () -> T): Flow<Resource<T>> = flow {
    emit(Resource.Loading)
    val result = try {
        Resource.Data(block.invoke())
    } catch (exception: CancellationException) {
        throw exception
    } catch (@Suppress("TooGenericExceptionCaught") exception: Exception) {
        Resource.Error(exception)
    }
    emit(result)
}

import com.fxrates.data.remote.dto.TimeSeriesDto
import com.fxrates.domain.model.CurrencyRate
import com.ionspin.kotlin.bignum.decimal.BigDecimal
import com.ionspin.kotlin.bignum.decimal.toBigDecimal
import kotlinx.datetime.LocalDate
import me.tatarka.inject.annotations.Inject

@Inject
class RatesConverter {

    /**
     * Takes the last two dates of [timeSeries] as "latest" and "previous". A currency with no
     * name in [currencies] is still shown, under its code.
     */
    fun toLatestRates(timeSeries: TimeSeriesDto, currencies: Map<String, String>): List<CurrencyRate> {
        val datesDescending = timeSeries.rates.keys.sortedDescending()
        val latestDate = datesDescending.firstOrNull() ?: return emptyList()
        val latest = timeSeries.rates.getValue(latestDate)
        val previous = datesDescending.getOrNull(1)?.let(timeSeries.rates::getValue).orEmpty()
        return latest
            .map { (code, rate) ->
                CurrencyRate(
                    code = code,
                    name = currencies[code] ?: code,
                    date = LocalDate.parse(latestDate),
                    rate = rate.toDecimal(),
                    previousRate = previous[code]?.toDecimal(),
                )
            }
            .sortedBy(CurrencyRate::code)
    }

    // Going through the string keeps the decimal digits the API sent: 0.89158 stays 0.89158
    // instead of the nearest binary double.
    private fun Double.toDecimal(): BigDecimal = toString().toBigDecimal()

}

import com.fxrates.data.remote.FrankfurterApi
import com.fxrates.domain.model.CurrencyRate
import com.fxrates.domain.repository.RatesRepository
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.coroutineScope
import kotlinx.datetime.DatePeriod
import kotlinx.datetime.TimeZone
import kotlinx.datetime.minus
import kotlinx.datetime.todayIn
import me.tatarka.inject.annotations.Inject
import kotlin.time.Clock

@Inject
class RatesRepositoryImpl(
    private val api: FrankfurterApi,
    private val converter: RatesConverter,
    private val clock: Clock,
) : RatesRepository {

    override suspend fun getLatestRates(base: String): List<CurrencyRate> = coroutineScope {
        // A week back always holds at least two business days, even around long holidays.
        val start = clock.todayIn(TimeZone.UTC).minus(DatePeriod(days = LOOKBACK_DAYS))
        val currencies = async { api.getCurrencies() }
        val timeSeries = async { api.getTimeSeries(base = base, start = start) }
        converter.toLatestRates(timeSeries = timeSeries.await(), currencies = currencies.await())
    }

    private companion object {

        const val LOOKBACK_DAYS = 7

    }

}

class FrankfurterApi(

) {

    /** Currency code → English name. */
    suspend fun getCurrencies(): Map<String, String> = httpClient.get("currencies").body()

    /**
     * The rates for every business day from [start] to [end] inclusive; `null` [end] means

    suspend fun getTimeSeries(base: String, start: LocalDate, end: LocalDate? = null): TimeSeriesDto {
        val path = "$start..${end ?: ""}"
        return httpClient.get(path) {
            parameter("base", base)
        }.body()
    }

import me.tatarka.inject.annotations.Inject

@Inject
internal class RatesListUiStateConverter {

    fun createUiState(state: RatesListStore.State): RatesListUiState {
        val rates = state.rates
        val subtitle = when (rates) {
            is Resource.Data -> {
                rates.value.firstOrNull()?.let { rate -> Strings.ratesSubtitle(state.base, rate.date.toString()) }
                    ?: String.Empty
            }
            is Resource.Loading, is Resource.Error -> {
                String.Empty
            }
        }
        return RatesListUiState(
            subtitle = subtitle,
            query = state.query,
            isRefreshEnabled = rates !is Resource.Loading,
            content = createContent(rates = rates, query = state.query),
        )
    }

    private fun createContent(rates: Resource<List<CurrencyRate>>, query: String): Content = when (rates) {
        is Resource.Loading -> {
            Content.Loading
        }
        is Resource.Error -> {
            Content.Error
        }
        is Resource.Data -> {
            val items = rates.value
                .filter { rate -> rate.matches(query.trim()) }
                .map(::toItem)
            if (items.isEmpty()) Content.NothingFound else Content.Items(items)
        }
    }

    private fun CurrencyRate.matches(query: String): Boolean {
        return query.isEmpty() || code.contains(query, ignoreCase = true) || name.contains(query, ignoreCase = true)
    }

    private fun toItem(rate: CurrencyRate): RateItem {
        val change = rate.previousRate?.let { previous -> RateChangeCalculator.calculate(previous, rate.rate) }
        val trend = when {
            change == null || change.absolute.isZero() -> Trend.Flat
            change.absolute.isPositive -> Trend.Up
            else -> Trend.Down
        }
        return RateItem(
            code = rate.code,
            name = rate.name,
            rate = NumberFormatter.formatRate(rate.rate),
            change = change?.let { value -> NumberFormatter.formatSignedPercent(value.percent) },
            trend = trend,
        )
    }

}

The first run exposed a scheduling bug in the Back test. I switched to a synchronous Store label subscription so the test observes the event deterministically. The rerun passed all 67 host tests, Detekt, and APK assembly. The APK installed successfully. Device interaction checks are outside my test assignment.
